title: TerraFusion PR Evidence Pack Contract
description: Keystone aggregator contract for all lane audit receipts with cryptographic integrity

contractVersion.description: Semantic version of this contract schema (must match skill version)

generatedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when evidence pack was generated

overallStatus.description: Strict rollup: ANY child FAIL → overall FAIL

lanesAudited.description: List of lanes that were audited (may be empty if no lane-specific contracts found)

skillName.description: Name of the skill that generated this contract (e.g., 'tf-ui-foundation')

status.description: Status of this specific skill audit

violationsCount.description: Number of violations found by this skill (0 for PASS)

artifactPath.description: Relative path to the contract artifact (from repo root)

hash.description: SHA-256 hash of the artifact file (format: 'sha256:hex')

cid.description: Optional IPFS CID (Content Identifier) for decentralized audit trail

executedAt.description: Timestamp when this skill was executed

contracts.description: Array of all lane-specific contracts aggregated into this evidence pack

totalViolations.description: Sum of violationsCount across all contracts

contextHash.description: SHA-256 hash of Context Pack (.terrafusion/context/latest.json) at build time

markdownSnippet.description: PR-ready markdown snippet for GitHub PR body injection

tdcVersion.description: TDC CLI version used to generate this pack

ciEnvironment.description: CI environment where pack was generated

triggeredBy.description: User or automation that triggered the build

rollupRules.description: Strict rollup logic enforced by Evidence Pack aggregator
rules: ELSE IF any contract.status === 'WARN' THEN overallStatus = 'WARN'
ELSE IF all contracts.status === 'SKIP' THEN overallStatus = 'SKIP'

integrityValidation.description: Cryptographic integrity checks performed by 'tdc evidence validate'
checks: Re-compute SHA-256 for each artifact in contracts[] array
Compare computed hash with stored hash (any mismatch = FAIL)
Compare computed contextHash with stored contextHash (mismatch = WARN)
Validate all artifact files exist at specified paths (missing = FAIL)
Validate JSON against this schema (invalid = FAIL)
